title: ECOM E04EP-4S+RM 4-Port EPON OLT with 10G SFP+ Uplink – Rack Mount

items.h: Device Type: EPON OLT (Optical Line Terminal)

Uplink Ports:

                          4 × SFP / SFP+ (10G supported)

                           4 × Gigabit Ethernet (RJ45)
ONU Support: Up to 64 ONUs per PON port
Total ONU Capacity: Up to 256 ONUs

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The ECOM E04EP-4S+RM EPON OLT is a carrier-grade EPON solution ideal for ISPs, telecom operators, and enterprise fiber deployments. Featuring 4 EPON PON ports, this OLT supports up to 256 ONUs, enabling efficient fiber distribution for residential and commercial users.


Equipped with 10G SFP+ uplink ports, the E04EP-4S+RM ensures high-bandwidth backhaul connectivity to core networks. Its 1U 19-inch rack-mount design makes it suitable for data centers, central offices, and telecom racks.


The OLT supports advanced network management through Web GUI, CLI, SNMP, and Telnet, allowing easy monitoring, configuration, and maintenance. It is fully compliant with IEEE 802.3ah EPON standards and supports triple-play services including Internet, IPTV, and VoIP.


This EPON OLT is a reliable and scalable solution for modern FTTH networks in Bangladesh and beyond.


Key Features


  • High-performance 4-Port EPON OLT
  • 10G SFP+ uplink for high-speed backbone connection
  • Supports large-scale FTTH deployments
  • Stable and reliable carrier-grade hardware
  • Easy network management & monitoring
  • Space-saving 1U rack-mount design
  • Cost-effective solution for ISPs
